summary: This is an Architonic product page for the Busch-Jaeger Blind switch/push-switch, a control for moving blinds or roller blinds in two directions using separate rockers. The page describes its available colours and switch ranges, a design-focused concept statement, and its categorisation under Smart Home and Shuter/Blind controls. It also lists the manufacturer's contact details, the Alpha family, related products, and catalogue downloads, most of which is site navigation and form boilerplate.
one_line: Architonic product page for Busch-Jaeger's blind switch/push-switch, a two-direction roller blind control in several colours and switch ranges.
key_facts: The Busch-Jaeger blind switch/push-button allows the blind or roller blind to be moved in two different directions of travel with separate rockers.
The control elements for the blind management system are available in different attractive colours to suit the ambience.
The product is available in different switch ranges.
The product is categorised in Smart Home - Shuter / Blind controls - Interior construction.
The product is part of the collection MANAGEMENT OF BLINDS.
The manufacturer is Busch-Jaeger and the product belongs to the Alpha family.
The Architonic ID for this product is 1566668.
Busch-Jaeger's address is Freisenbergstraße 2, 58513 Lüdenscheid Germany.
Busch-Jaeger's phone number is 02351 956-1600 and its fax is +49 2351 956 1 694.
The concept text states that switch ranges from Busch-Jaeger are a visual highlight on all backgrounds and meet the highest demands for quality and beauty in design.

The Alpha family includes the Blind key switch, Blind switch/push-switch with rotary knob, Busch-Blind comfort switch, Busch-Blind control II, Data Communication System (DCS), SCHUKO® socket outlet with hinged lid, and Telephone Connection Unit.
A downloadable Lichtschalter catalogue from 2023 is listed under the latest catalogues.
